note: First-party OWASP Benchmark v1.2 result for Zennoxa Shield. Shield-only — contains no competitor data.

tool.name: Zennoxa Shield
tool.engine: SAST — regex + intra-file taint + dataflow (constant-fold / key-sensitive maps)
tool.release_note: This figure is measured on the current Shield engine and is reproducible from the public OWASP dataset with the scoring method below. A version-matched public CLI release is in preparation; the latest published CLI release may score differently.

benchmark.score_metric: Benchmark Score = True Positive Rate − False Positive Rate (Youden's J), strict OWASP CWE-per-category match; higher is better

reproduce: Scan the suite with the Shield CLI: shield scan BenchmarkJava/src/main/java/org/owasp/benchmark/testcode --format sarif --output shield.sarif
Score shield.sarif against BenchmarkJava/expectedresults-1.2.csv using OWASP's own published scoring tooling (strict CWE-per-category match).
The score depends on the Shield engine version; this result is from engine commit 515fff7 (measured 2026-08-04, re-verified 2026-08-13).
reproducibility_note: Every figure here is produced on the public OWASP Benchmark v1.2 suite (2,740 labelled Java cases). To compare other tools, use OWASP's own published scorecards; run every tool at its default configuration.
